import csv
import io


def encode_rows(columns, rows):
    output = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.writer(output, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(columns)
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return output.getvalue()

"""One isolated OpenCode session per task and explicitly invoked writing skill."""
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, random, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, threading
import relay_base as core
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CONDITIONS=['variant-a','variant-b']
core.ROOT=ROOT
core.CONDITIONS=CONDITIONS
core.TIMEOUT=420
core.REQUEST_LIMIT=32
core.OUTPUT_BUDGET=32768

def setup(run,condition,case):
    for rel in ['home/.config/opencode','home/.cache/opencode','work','input','tools']:
        (run/rel).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    for name, content in case.get('files', {}).items():
        target=run/'work'/name; target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); target.write_text(content)
    if condition!='none':shutil.copytree(ROOT/'snapshots'/condition,run/'input/skill')
    shutil.copy2(ROOT/'scripts/sandbox_bridge.py',run/'tools/sandbox_bridge.py')
    (run/'home/.cache/opencode/models.json').write_text('{}\n')
    (run/'tools/passwd').write_text(f'eval:x:{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}:Evaluation:/home/eval:/bin/bash\n')
    config={'$schema':'https://opencode.ai/config.json','model':'evaluation/'+core.MODEL,'small_model':'evaluation/'+core.MODEL,
      'enabled_providers':['evaluation'],'autoupdate':False,'share':'disabled','snapshot':False,'plugin':[],'instructions':[],
      'provider':{'evaluation':{'npm':'@ai-sdk/openai-compatible','name':'Evaluation relay','options':{'baseURL':'http://127.0.0.1:18761/v1','apiKey':'non-secret-placeholder'},
        'models':{core.MODEL:{'name':core.MODEL,'options':{'reasoningEffort':'high'},'limit':{'context':131072,'output':16384},'modalities':{'input':['text'],'output':['text']}}}}},
      'agent':{'eval':{'description':'Complete the current task','mode':'primary','prompt':core.BASE+'\nPython 3 is available. /work is writable. Public web access is available through webfetch and command-line HTTPS. Node.js and Python 3 are available. Use only public sources; no accounts or credentials are provided.',
        'permission':{'*':'deny','read':'allow','write':'allow','edit':'allow','bash':'allow','glob':'allow','grep':'allow','list':'allow','external_directory':'allow','webfetch':'allow','websearch':'allow','task':'allow'}}},
      'default_agent':'eval','formatter':False,'lsp':False}
    core.write_json(run/'home/.config/opencode/opencode.json',config)
    return config

def command(run,condition,args):
    return ['bwrap','--die-with-parent','--unshare-all','--share-net','--ro-bind','/usr','/usr','--symlink','usr/bin','/bin','--ro-bind','/lib','/lib','--ro-bind','/lib64','/lib64',
      '--proc','/proc','--dev','/dev','--tmpfs','/tmp','--dir','/etc','--ro-bind','/etc/alternatives','/etc/alternatives','--ro-bind','/etc/resolv.conf','/etc/resolv.conf','--ro-bind','/etc/ssl/certs','/etc/ssl/certs',
      '--ro-bind',str(run/'tools/passwd'),'/etc/passwd','--ro-bind',str(core.BINARY),'/opt/opencode',
      '--bind',str(run/'home'),'/home/eval','--bind',str(run/'work'),'/work','--ro-bind',str(run/'input'),'/input',
      '--ro-bind',str(run/'tools'),'/tools','--ro-bind',str(core.SOCKET_PATH),'/run/model.sock','--chdir','/work','--',*args]

def audit_fs(run,condition):
    code='''import json,pathlib,socket
p=pathlib.Path
paths=['/home/operator','/input/skill/SKILL.md','/home/eval/.codex/skills','/home/eval/.agents/skills','/input/specialists','/review','/workspace']
s=socket.socket();s.settimeout(1)
try:s.connect(('1.1.1.1',443));network=True
except OSError:network=False
print(json.dumps({'paths':{x:p(x).exists() for x in paths},'external_network':network,'input_files':[str(x.relative_to('/input')) for x in p('/input').rglob('*') if x.is_file()]}))'''
    p=subprocess.run(command(run,condition,['python3','-c',code]),env=core.environment(),capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=15)
    result=json.loads(p.stdout)
    assert result['paths']['/input/skill/SKILL.md']==(condition!='none')
    assert not any(v for k,v in result['paths'].items() if k!='/input/skill/SKILL.md')
    # Public networking is enabled equally for both conditions.
    core.write_json(run/'filesystem-audit.json',result)

core.setup=setup
core.command=command
core.audit_fs=audit_fs

def audit_requests(results):
    summaries=[]
    for r in results:
        run=ROOT/'preflight'/r['id']
        body=next(json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted(run.glob('request-*.json')) if json.loads(p.read_text()).get('tools'))
        assert body['model']==core.MODEL
        raw=json.dumps(body)
        assert all(x not in raw for x in ['/home/operator','visual-skill','oh-my-opencode','skill-creator'])
        summaries.append({'condition':r['condition'],'model':body['model'],'reasoning_effort':body.get('reasoning_effort'),'max_tokens':body.get('max_tokens',body.get('max_completion_tokens')),'tools':[x['function']['name'] for x in body['tools']]})
    core.write_json(ROOT/'preflight/request-audit.json',summaries)

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('mode',choices=['audit','probe','run']);parser.add_argument('--model',default='deepseek-flash');args=parser.parse_args()
    core.MODEL=args.model;core.MOCK=args.mode=='audit'
    if not core.MOCK:core.PROVIDER=core.provider()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='writing-relay-') as tmp:
        core.SOCKET_PATH=Path(tmp)/'api.sock';server=core.UnixServer(str(core.SOCKET_PATH),core.Relay)
        threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
        try:
            if args.mode=='audit':
                jobs=[{'id':'audit-'+c,'condition':c,'prompt':'Reply only OK. Do not use tools.','fixtures':[]} for c in CONDITIONS]
            elif args.mode=='probe':
                jobs=[{'id':'health-'+args.model,'condition':'none','prompt':'Reply only OK. Do not use tools.','fixtures':[]}]
            else:
                assert (ROOT/'preflight/request-audit.json').exists()
                cases=json.loads((ROOT/'inputs/cases.json').read_text())['cases'];jobs=[]
                for case in cases:
                    order=CONDITIONS.copy();random.Random('reuse-20261015-'+case['id']).shuffle(order)
                    jobs.extend({**case,'case':case['id'],'id':case['id']+'-'+c,'condition':c,'repeat':1} for c in order)
                core.write_json(ROOT/'jobs.json',jobs)
                # Existing attempt directories are never retried or overwritten.
                jobs=[j for j in jobs if not (ROOT/'runs'/j['id']).exists()]
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
                results=[f.result() for f in as_completed([pool.submit(core.execute,j,args.mode!='run') for j in jobs])]
            if core.MOCK:audit_requests(results)
        finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close()

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Run the frozen comparison using OpenCode, offline tools, and a host-only API relay."""
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
import argparse
import hashlib
import http.server
import json
import os
import random
import re
import shutil
import signal
import socketserver
import subprocess
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BINARY = Path('/home/operator/.opencode/bin/opencode')
MODEL = 'grok-4.7'
CONDITIONS = ['visual-skill']
BASE = 'You are an assistant. Complete the user task accurately. Use available tools when useful. Respect the requested output format.'
TOOLS = 'Local tools: Python 3, Node.js 20, Graphviz, Chromium. For HTML/SVG/Mermaid screenshots or Playwright interaction use node /tools/browser.mjs help. Local Mermaid bundle: /tools/mermaid.min.js. Input files are read-only; /work is writable.'
STATE = {}
LOCK = threading.Lock()
PROVIDER = None
MOCK = False
SOCKET_PATH = None
OUTPUT_BUDGET = 131072
REQUEST_LIMIT = 64
TIMEOUT = 900
PLAYWRIGHT = Path('/home/operator/.npm/_npx/8ef14e20fba81900/node_modules')
CHROMIUM = Path('/home/operator/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1155/chrome-linux')


def write_json(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')


def provider():
    result = subprocess.run([str(BINARY), 'debug', 'config', '--pure'], cwd='/tmp', capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
    for i, ch in enumerate(result.stdout):
        if ch != '{':
            continue
        try:
            data, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(result.stdout[i:])
            if isinstance(data, dict) and 'provider' in data:
                return data['provider']['llmproxy']
        except ValueError:
            pass
    raise RuntimeError('Existing provider unavailable; raw configuration suppressed')


class UnixServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, socketserver.UnixStreamServer):
    daemon_threads = True


class Relay(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'

    def log_message(self, *_):
        pass

    def reply(self, status, payload, stream=False):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream' if stream else 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(payload)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(payload)

    def do_POST(self):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'/([a-f0-9]{16})/v1/chat/completions', self.path)
        if not match or match[1] not in STATE:
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        state = STATE[match[1]]
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers['Content-Length'])))
        title = any(m.get('role') == 'system' and str(m.get('content', '')).startswith('You are a title generator.') for m in body.get('messages', []))
        with LOCK:
            index = state['requests']
            state['requests'] += 1
        write_json(state['run'] / f'request-{index:03}.json', body)
        if MOCK or title:
            text = 'OFFLINE_AUDIT_OK'
            payload = {'id': 'audit', 'object': 'chat.completion', 'created': 1, 'model': MODEL, 'choices': [{'index': 0, 'message': {'role': 'assistant', 'content': text}, 'finish_reason': 'stop'}], 'usage': {'prompt_tokens': 0, 'completion_tokens': 0, 'total_tokens': 0}}
            if body.get('stream'):
                chunk = {'id': 'audit', 'object': 'chat.completion.chunk', 'created': 1, 'model': MODEL, 'choices': [{'index': 0, 'delta': {'role': 'assistant', 'content': text}, 'finish_reason': None}]}
                raw = ('data: ' + json.dumps(chunk) + '\n\ndata: [DONE]\n\n').encode()
            else:
                raw = json.dumps(payload).encode()
            self.reply(200, raw, body.get('stream', False))
            return
        if state['model_requests'] >= REQUEST_LIMIT or state['output_tokens'] >= OUTPUT_BUDGET:
            state['budget_exhausted'] = True
            self.reply(400, b'{"error":{"message":"Task generation budget exhausted","type":"budget_exhausted"}}')
            return
        remaining = OUTPUT_BUDGET - state['output_tokens']
        token_field = 'max_completion_tokens' if 'max_completion_tokens' in body else 'max_tokens'
        if body.get(token_field, 65536) > remaining:
            body[token_field] = remaining
            write_json(state['run'] / f'effective-request-{index:03}.json', body)
        state['model_requests'] += 1
        opts = PROVIDER['options']
        headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + opts['apiKey']}
        headers.update(opts.get('headers', {}))
        req = urllib.request.Request(opts['baseURL'].rstrip('/') + '/chat/completions', data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers=headers, method='POST')
        chunks = []
        started = time.time()
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=240) as response:
                self.send_response(response.status)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', response.headers.get('Content-Type', 'application/json'))
                self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
                self.end_headers()
                while data := response.read1(65536):
                    chunks.append(data)
                    self.wfile.write(data)
                    self.wfile.flush()
        except (urllib.error.HTTPError, urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError) as error:
            code = getattr(error, 'code', 502)
            write_json(state['run'] / f'upstream-error-{index:03}.json', {'status': code, 'type': type(error).__name__})
            if not chunks:
                self.reply(code, json.dumps({'error': {'message': f'Evaluation upstream HTTP {code}', 'type': 'upstream_error'}}).encode())
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
            pass
        finally:
            self.close_connection = True
            raw = b''.join(chunks)
            (state['run'] / f'response-{index:03}.txt').write_bytes(raw)
            usage = {}
            reasons = []
            records = [raw] if not body.get('stream') else [line[6:] for line in raw.splitlines() if line.startswith(b'data: ') and line[6:] != b'[DONE]']
            for record in records:
                try:
                    value = json.loads(record)
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if value.get('usage'):
                    usage = value['usage']
                reasons += [c['finish_reason'] for c in value.get('choices', []) if c.get('finish_reason')]
            state['output_tokens'] += usage.get('completion_tokens', 0)
            write_json(state['run'] / f'usage-{index:03}.json', {'usage': usage, 'finish_reasons': reasons, 'seconds': round(time.time() - started, 3)})


def environment():
    return {'HOME': '/home/eval', 'USER': 'eval', 'LANG': 'C.UTF-8', 'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin', 'SHELL': '/bin/bash',
            'OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE': 'true', 'OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH': 'true', 'OPENCODE_DISABLE_DEFAULT_PLUGINS': 'true', 'OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE': 'true',
            'OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_OUTPUT_TOKEN_MAX': '65536'}


def setup(run, condition, case):
    for rel in ['home/.config/opencode', 'home/.cache/opencode', 'work', 'input/fixtures', 'tools']:
        (run / rel).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for fixture in case.get('fixtures', []):
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / 'inputs/fixtures' / fixture, run / 'input/fixtures' / fixture)
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / 'manifest.json').read_text())
    for rel in manifest['generation_skill_allowlist'][condition]:
        dst = run / 'input/skill' / rel
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / 'snapshots' / condition / rel, dst)
    catalog = []
    if condition == 'visual-skill':
        (run / 'input/specialists').mkdir()
        for name in manifest['generation_specialist_allowlist'][condition]:
            path = ROOT / 'dependencies/skills' / name / 'SKILL.md'
            source = path.read_text()
            import yaml
            metadata = yaml.safe_load(source.split('---', 2)[1])
            assert not metadata.get('disable-model-invocation'), name
            catalog.append({'name': metadata['name'], 'description': metadata['description'], 'path': f'/input/specialists/{name}/SKILL.md'})
    (run / 'home/.cache/opencode/models.json').write_text('{}\n')
    extra = '\nAvailable optional skills; read the listed SKILL.md when needed:\n' + json.dumps(catalog, ensure_ascii=False) if catalog else ''
    config = {'$schema': 'https://opencode.ai/config.json', 'model': 'evaluation/' + MODEL, 'small_model': 'evaluation/' + MODEL,
              'enabled_providers': ['evaluation'], 'autoupdate': False, 'share': 'disabled', 'snapshot': False, 'plugin': [], 'instructions': [],
              'provider': {'evaluation': {'npm': '@ai-sdk/openai-compatible', 'name': 'Evaluation relay', 'options': {'baseURL': 'http://127.0.0.1:18761/v1', 'apiKey': 'non-secret-placeholder'},
                            'models': {MODEL: {'name': MODEL, 'options': {'reasoningEffort': 'high'}, 'limit': {'context': 450000, 'output': 65536}, 'modalities': {'input': ['text', 'image'], 'output': ['text']}}}}},
              'agent': {'eval': {'description': 'Complete the current task', 'mode': 'primary', 'prompt': BASE + '\n' + TOOLS + extra,
                         'permission': {'*': 'deny', 'read': 'allow', 'write': 'allow', 'edit': 'allow', 'bash': 'allow', 'glob': 'allow', 'grep': 'allow', 'list': 'allow', 'external_directory': 'allow'}}},
              'default_agent': 'eval', 'formatter': False, 'lsp': False}
    write_json(run / 'home/.config/opencode/opencode.json', config)
    write_json(run / 'catalog-audit.json', catalog)
    for name in ['browser.mjs', 'sandbox_bridge.py']:
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / 'scripts' / name, run / 'tools' / name)
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / 'dependencies/runtime/mermaid.min.js', run / 'tools/mermaid.min.js')
    return config


def command(run, condition, args):
    cmd = ['bwrap', '--die-with-parent', '--unshare-all', '--ro-bind', '/usr', '/usr', '--symlink', 'usr/bin', '/bin', '--ro-bind', '/lib', '/lib', '--ro-bind', '/lib64', '/lib64',
           '--proc', '/proc', '--dev', '/dev', '--tmpfs', '/tmp', '--dir', '/etc', '--ro-bind', '/etc/alternatives', '/etc/alternatives', '--ro-bind', '/etc/fonts', '/etc/fonts',
           '--ro-bind', str(BINARY), '/opt/opencode', '--bind', str(run / 'home'), '/home/eval', '--bind', str(run / 'work'), '/work', '--ro-bind', str(run / 'input'), '/input',
           '--ro-bind', str(run / 'tools'), '/tools', '--ro-bind', str(SOCKET_PATH), '/run/model.sock',
           '--ro-bind', str(PLAYWRIGHT / 'playwright'), '/runtime/node_modules/playwright', '--ro-bind', str(PLAYWRIGHT / 'playwright-core'), '/runtime/node_modules/playwright-core',
           '--ro-bind', str(CHROMIUM), '/runtime/chromium']
    if condition == 'visual-skill':
        cmd += ['--ro-bind', str(ROOT / 'dependencies/skills'), '/input/specialists']
    return cmd + ['--chdir', '/work', '--', *args]


def audit_fs(run, condition):
    probe = '''import json,pathlib,shutil,socket
p=pathlib.Path
paths=["/home/operator", "/input/skill/SKILL.md", "/input/skill/references/evaluation.md", "/input/specialists/diagram-extension/SKILL.md", "/input/specialists/design-extension/SKILL.md", "/input/specialists/html-extension/scripts/am.mjs", "/home/eval/.codex/skills", "/home/eval/.agents/skills", "/home/eval/.config/opencode/skills"]
out={"paths":{x:p(x).exists() for x in paths},"am_in_path":shutil.which("am"),"interfaces":socket.if_nameindex()}
sock=socket.socket();sock.settimeout(1)
try:sock.connect(("1.1.1.1",443));out["external_network"]=True
except OSError:out["external_network"]=False
print(json.dumps(out))'''
    result = subprocess.run(command(run, condition, ['/usr/bin/python3', '-c', probe]), env=environment(), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15, check=True)
    report = json.loads(result.stdout)
    paths = report['paths']
    assert paths['/input/skill/SKILL.md'] == (condition != 'none')
    assert all(value == (condition == 'visual-skill') for key, value in paths.items() if key.startswith('/input/specialists/'))
    assert not any(value for key, value in paths.items() if key.startswith('/home/') or key.endswith('/evaluation.md'))
    assert not report['external_network'] and not report['am_in_path']
    assert report['interfaces'] == [[1, 'lo']]
    write_json(run / 'filesystem-audit.json', report)


def execute(job, preflight=False):
    run = ROOT / ('preflight' if preflight else 'runs') / job['id']
    if run.exists():
        raise RuntimeError('Refusing to overwrite ' + str(run))
    run.mkdir(parents=True)
    key = hashlib.sha256(job['id'].encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    state = {'run': run, 'requests': 0, 'model_requests': 0, 'output_tokens': 0, 'budget_exhausted': False}
    STATE[key] = state
    setup(run, job['condition'], job)
    audit_fs(run, job['condition'])
    prompt = '完成下面的用户请求。输入文件只读；需要文件产物时写入 /work，并在最终回复给出文件路径。只完成当前请求。\n\n'
    if job['condition'] != 'none':
        prompt = '用户显式要求使用本题提供的 skill。先读取 /input/skill/SKILL.md。\n\n' + prompt
    prompt += job['prompt']
    if job.get('delivery') == 'html':
        prompt += '\n\n文件交付位置：/work/answer.html。'
    if job.get('delivery') == 'svg':
        prompt += '\n\n文件交付位置：/work/answer.svg。'
    (run / 'prompt.txt').write_text(prompt)
    launch = 'python3 /tools/sandbox_bridge.py "$1" > /tmp/bridge.log 2>&1 &\nexec /opt/opencode run --pure --format json --agent eval -m evaluation/grok-4.7 "$2"'
    launch = launch.replace('evaluation/grok-4.7', 'evaluation/' + MODEL)
    args = ['/bin/bash', '-c', launch, 'eval-launch', key, prompt]
    started = time.time()
    with (run / 'events.jsonl').open('w') as out, (run / 'stderr.log').open('w') as err:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(command(run, job['condition'], args), env=environment(), stdout=out, stderr=err, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            code = proc.wait(timeout=90 if preflight else TIMEOUT)
            try: os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            except ProcessLookupError: pass
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                proc.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                proc.wait()
            code = 'timeout'
    events = []
    for line in (run / 'events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
        try:
            events.append(json.loads(line))
        except ValueError:
            pass
    texts = [e['part']['text'] for e in events if e.get('type') == 'text']
    (run / 'answer.md').write_text('\n\n'.join(texts) + '\n')
    result = {**job, 'exit': code, 'seconds': round(time.time() - started, 2), 'requests': state['requests'], 'model_requests': state['model_requests'],
              'output_tokens': state['output_tokens'], 'budget_exhausted': state['budget_exhausted'], 'has_text': bool(texts),
              'artifacts': [str(p.relative_to(run / 'work')) for p in (run / 'work').rglob('*') if p.is_file()], 'errors': [e for e in events if e.get('type') == 'error']}
    write_json(run / 'result.json', result)
    print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ['id', 'exit', 'seconds', 'model_requests', 'has_text', 'budget_exhausted']}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    return result


def audit_requests(results):
    reports = []
    for result in results:
        run = ROOT / 'preflight' / result['id']
        requests = sorted(run.glob('request-*.json'))
        assert requests, result['id']
        raw = next(p.read_text() for p in requests if json.loads(p.read_text()).get('tools'))
        body = json.loads(raw)
        assert body['model'] == MODEL
        assert body.get('max_tokens', body.get('max_completion_tokens')) == 65536
        assert all(x not in raw for x in ['2026-10-10-dual-model', '/home/operator', 'skill-creator', 'oh-my-opencode'])
        for name in ['diagram-extension', 'design-extension', 'html-extension']:
            assert (name in raw) == (result['condition'] == 'visual-skill'), (result['id'], name)
        assert [t['function']['name'] for t in body['tools']] == ['bash', 'read', 'glob', 'grep', 'edit', 'write']
        reports.append({'condition': result['condition'], 'model': MODEL, 'max_tokens': body.get('max_tokens', body.get('max_completion_tokens')), 'tools': [t['function']['name'] for t in body['tools']], 'specialist_metadata_correct': True, 'requests': len(requests)})
    write_json(ROOT / 'preflight/request-audit.json', reports)


def main():
    global PROVIDER, MOCK, SOCKET_PATH
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('mode', choices=['audit', 'probe', 'run'])
    parser.add_argument('--label', default='')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    MOCK = args.mode == 'audit'
    if not MOCK:
        PROVIDER = provider()
    relay_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='ve-relay-'))
    SOCKET_PATH = relay_dir / 'api.sock'
    server = UnixServer(str(SOCKET_PATH), Relay)
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    try:
        if args.mode == 'audit':
            jobs = [{'id': 'audit-' + args.label + c, 'condition': c, 'prompt': 'Reply only OK. Do not use tools.', 'fixtures': []} for c in CONDITIONS]
        elif args.mode == 'probe':
            jobs = [{'id': 'live-probe' + args.label, 'condition': 'none', 'prompt': 'Reply only OK. Do not use tools.', 'fixtures': []}]
        else:
            assert (ROOT / 'preflight/request-audit.json').exists(), 'Run offline audit first'
            cases = json.loads((ROOT / 'inputs/cases.json').read_text())['cases']
            jobs = []
            for rep in range(1, 2):
                for case in cases:
                    conditions = CONDITIONS.copy()
                    random.Random(f'visual-content-{rep}-{case["id"]}').shuffle(conditions)
                    for condition in conditions:
                        jobs.append({**case, 'case': case['id'], 'id': f'r{rep}-{case["id"]}-{condition}', 'condition': condition, 'repeat': rep})
            write_json(ROOT / 'jobs.json', jobs)
            jobs = [j for j in jobs if not (ROOT / 'runs' / j['id'] / 'result.json').exists()]
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
            results = [f.result() for f in as_completed([pool.submit(execute, j, args.mode != 'run') for j in jobs])]
        if MOCK:
            audit_requests(results)
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        SOCKET_PATH.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        relay_dir.rmdir()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Expose only the host model relay to an otherwise offline network namespace."""
import http.client
import http.server
import socket
import sys
import threading


class UnixConnection(http.client.HTTPConnection):
    def connect(self):
        self.sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        self.sock.settimeout(240)
        self.sock.connect("/run/model.sock")


class Bridge(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def log_message(self, *_):
        pass

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path != "/v1/chat/completions":
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
        conn = UnixConnection("relay", timeout=240)
        try:
            conn.request("POST", "/" + sys.argv[1] + self.path, body, {"Content-Type": "application/json"})
            response = conn.getresponse()
            self.send_response(response.status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", response.getheader("Content-Type", "application/json"))
            self.send_header("Connection", "close")
            self.end_headers()
            while data := response.read1(65536):
                self.wfile.write(data)
                self.wfile.flush()
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
            pass
        finally:
            conn.close()
            self.close_connection = True


if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 18761), Bridge)
    server.serve_forever()

# Existing evaluation workflow — observed context

This is a real workflow in AI-SDLC, a repository collecting and evaluating agent skills. The supplied scripts are an actual recent harness; host usernames and treatment names are anonymized. run.py overrides relay_base.py setup/command/audit functions and budget values. Some legacy code remains in relay_base.py.

The machine is Linux; Python 3, bubblewrap, Node.js and OpenCode 1.14.28 are available. The active generator is OpenCode calling an OpenAI-compatible llmproxy endpoint. Some earlier visual evaluations used a separate container/browser renderer and two image feedback rounds. Writing evaluations are offline; reuse/selection evaluations need public web tools. Six-session and twenty-session batches have actually been run; no service-scale throughput requirement is known.

A run gets its own HOME/work/input, only its assigned skill package and fixtures. Host global skills, AGENTS instructions, peer outputs and review rubric must not leak into the generator. Provider authentication stays in the host relay, not model filesystem. The current online variant shares networking but isolates files; this is not a network security sandbox. The original model ID, wire requests, tool calls, output files, usage, timeout and failures matter. A test must exercise the coding agent's tool behavior, not only send its prompt directly to an LLM API. Subagent and summarization usage count toward the same run.

Each iteration currently copies prior scripts into a fresh directory, edits conditions/cases/budgets and reconstructs snapshots. Reports/methods are kept in Git; raw requests, outputs, browser artifacts and dependencies remain outside. Existing run directories must not silently be overwritten or retried. The current mechanism has run successfully, but script duplication is a maintenance concern.

No team size, cloud budget, CI requirement or SLA was supplied. Do not invent them as facts. There is no requirement to build a web dashboard, distributed scheduler, always-on service or new framework. Third-party source/docs may be inspected, but this task does not authorize installing/running candidates or changing the actual project.

# 评测报告与原始材料

本目录保存轻量报告、索引，以及可复用的测试方法、案例、协议和脚本。2026-10-15 清理前约 143 MB（恢复可复用测试资产后约 4 MB），主要是重复请求 JSON、截图、依赖副本与运行日志；这些内容已移出当前版本，原始证据仍完整保存在固定提交中。


保留报告的正文不改写，指向已移出文件的 Markdown 链接改为固定提交链接。历史报告描述的是当时状态，历史脚本、本机路径、归档结构和验证结果不代表当前文件布局。报告中的原始相对链接版本仍在上述固定提交中。

## 后续评测如何保存

仓库提交每轮报告及必要的测试方法、案例、协议、脚本和依赖锁文件。原始输入输出、可运行交付、图片、日志与依赖放在仓库外，例如 /tmp/ai-sdlc-evaluations/；需要长期共享时上传到可用的附件存储，在报告中记录地址、来源版本与 SHA-256。确认附件可下载后再声明已归档。不要提交逐请求完整上下文、依赖目录或打包副本。

根目录 .gitignore 对评测区实行轻量资产白名单。新增报告提交前检查暂存区体积；其他小型必要材料经判断后再有意识地调整规则。

## 减少 Git 下载量

删除当前文件不会删除旧 Git 对象。已经拥有旧版本的正常更新会删除这些文件，但不会自动收回 .git 的历史空间；首次完整克隆或跨越旧提交的完整拉取仍可能下载历史大文件。

只需要当前版本时，另建浅克隆即可避开旧历史：

```bash
git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --no-tags https://github.com/zaixi/AI-SDLC.git AI-SDLC-light
```

如果只使用 Skill，不需要资料库，可在服务端支持部分克隆时进一步只检出所需目录：

```bash
git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --no-tags --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/zaixi/AI-SDLC.git AI-SDLC-skills
cd AI-SDLC-skills
git sparse-checkout set skills scripts
```

materials/ 仍含约 107 MB 的参考资料，不在这次清理范围内。浅克隆整个工作区仍会下载这些当前文件；稀疏部分克隆可以避开它们。不支持过滤的服务端可能仍下载全部当前文件。

本次没有重写公共 Git 历史或强推。彻底清除历史对象需要另行规划历史迁移，并同步处理协作者克隆和固定版本归档；不能把本次文件清理说成已缩减完整历史。

# Observed storage constraints and unresolved choice

AI-SDLC is a public GitHub repository. Current evaluations are multiple cases × skill variants. Outputs include Markdown, full request/response JSON, generated HTML/SVG, screenshots, optional render assets, protocol, scripts and dependency locks. The latest small batch has six sessions; an earlier writing batch has twenty. Future growth and frequency are unknown.

A prior cleanup moved about 143 MB of evaluation material out of the current tree, retaining about 4 MB of reports/methods. Historical data remain in public commit b52aa156e6f6a6dca1d0aee0ebf3b227d62f2475; the commit ZIP contains the whole repository, not only evaluations. materials/ still contains about 107 MB of references and is outside the evaluation cleanup scope. No history rewrite has happened.

Recent raw runs live under a maintainer's local directory outside this repository and have not been published as shared attachments. This is a known availability gap. The repository has no configured shared object-storage account or upload workflow. Do not assume one exists. Publicly shared data must be inspected/redacted before publication; request logs may contain prompts, private paths or other sensitive context even if API credentials are handled separately.

Need: other people should fetch one chosen evaluation without cloning all old binaries, inspect original artifacts and verify their source/hash, then rerun its method when dependencies/access permit. Browsing a report is distinct from executing generated HTML or installing dependencies. Small files needed to understand and rerun a study can stay in Git. Local /tmp paths are not durable public archives. Existing report links must remain explainable through migration. No authorization to upload, deploy, delete, rewrite history or force-push in this design task.

Budget, per-artifact sizes, release cadence and long-term retention period have not been specified. State decision-relevant assumptions, and identify when they would change the choice. Do not turn unknown scale into a requirement for enterprise infrastructure.
